the creation of a Python module for crystallographic data reduction and structure determination, and with the development of a framework for automation and data processing in crystallography and electron cryo-microscopy.
the creation and application of an efficient, general‐purpose Python interface to Clipper, and with its integration into the existing crystallographic software suite.
the creation of a Python module for Clipper that is both efficient and user‐friendly.

the Clipper Python module is a powerful and flexible tool that can be used in a wide range of applications in both crystallography and cryo‐EM, and that it can help to automate many of the tedious tasks involved in protein structure determination.
the Python module is a valuable tool that will allow the crystallographic community to develop new methods and applications, and will facilitate the development of new algorithms.
